plan.rationale: Frozen objective is ttft_ms for single-device Qwen3-4B inference (batch 1, 256 prompt tokens, 32 new tokens) with no distributed backend, so communication dimensions are not_applicable and the open diagnostic question is whether the TTFT region is host-submit/synchronization-bound or GPU-execution-bound. The torch collector already ran with complete attribution (coverage.json: 66441/66441 kernels associated, 0 unassociated, 0 ambiguous forward sequences, 0 autograd ranges), so there are no overlap, graph-tracing, or attribution questions for nsys to resolve and it is not selected despite being available. collective_calibration is excluded because a synthetic full-world SUM allreduce is a reference experiment with no collectives to reference on a single device and is not a critical-path estimate. device_telemetry is not selected because its device-wide NVML readings with native windows cannot attribute to the millisecond-scale TTFT interval and no transfer or memory-pressure questions are open (model loading is outside timing). execution_timeline is selected for CPU-to-CUDA submit associations, synchronization events, per-device intervals, and CPU-submit clock alignment bounds to locate host-side stalls and sync points inside the workload boundary, with GPU readiness and consumer completion retained unknown where unreported. python_runtime is selected to investigate host dispatch and binding costs typical of batch-1 prefill, treating its perturbed inclusive/self times as host-side evidence only. Neither selected collector replaces a communication hook or determines subsequent search actions; no counters are requested indiscriminately and unavailable dimensions are listed with observed reasons.
